name: Icon map help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:icon-map (help@1): the Icon map page, its pack picker, the per-slot picks, the settings tab and the actions voice, search, MCP and the CLI reach.
author: Brett

entries.title: Icon map
entries.text: Every icon, badge and logo slot in every app, plugin and screen, with a live preview of what each one draws right now. Switch the icon pack to change every icon at once, or pick one place.
entries.tryIt: Type save in Search to see every place that shows a save icon.

entries.title: Icon map
entries.text: Opens the Icon map page (View → Icon map). Also reachable by voice ("open the icon map"), search, MCP and the CLI.

entries.title: Switch the icon pack
entries.text: Uses an icon pack by id, name or style word, for every icon in the console. Voice: "switch to the duotone icon pack". REST PUT /api/plugins/icon-map/pack, MCP icon-map_pack-set, CLI axf icon-map pack-set --pack duotone.

entries.title: Back to the branding icon pack
entries.text: Drops the hand-picked pack; the branding package's (or skin's) pack is in force again.

entries.title: Pick one slot's icon
entries.text: Makes one place draw a glyph: icon-map.slot.set:<slot id>:<glyph>. The pick wins over the pack until it is cleared.

entries.title: Drop one slot's pick
entries.text: The place follows the pack's role mapping or the framework glyph again.

entries.title: Reload the icon map
entries.text: Reads the state again (the pack and every pick) and redraws.

entries.title: Pack
entries.text: The icon pack to use. Framework glyphs is the branding default; a pack marked fixed colour keeps its own colours instead of following the skin.

entries.title: Use pack
entries.text: Switches every icon in the console to the chosen pack. Slots with a hand pick keep their pick.

entries.title: Back to branding pack
entries.text: Drops the hand-picked pack; the branding package's (or skin's) pack is in force again.

entries.title: Search
entries.text: Narrows the list by slot id, role, glyph, screen or file.

entries.title: Surface
entries.text: Only the slots on one surface: nav, toolbar, tab, menu, dialog, banner, widget, button, badge, logo, settings, view, status, card, grid, step or inline.

entries.title: App
entries.text: Only the slots of one app (the console, AmberX, axHub, the demo apps) or the framework chrome every app shares.

entries.title: Find a glyph
entries.text: Narrows the glyph grid in the slot panel. Click any glyph to make this one place draw it; the pick is saved at once.

entries.title: Clear pick
entries.text: Drops this slot's hand pick: it follows the pack's role mapping or the framework glyph again.

entries.title: Change
entries.text: Opens the slot panel for this place: previews at three sizes, why it draws what it draws (pick, pack role, pack glyph, framework) and the glyph grid to change it.

entries.title: Kind
entries.text: Only icons, only badges or only logos.

entries.title: Open one slot in the icon map
entries.text: Opens the Icon map on one slot's panel: icon-map.slot.open:<slot id>. Other UI tools use the axf.icon-map@1 web service for the same thing.

entries.title: Restore previous edit
entries.text: Puts this slot back to what it drew before its last edit. Pressing it again goes forward again (a restore is an edit too). REST POST /api/plugins/icon-map/slot/<id>/restore {from: previous}.

entries.title: Restore from axHub
entries.text: Puts this slot back to the icon axHub's look holds (read when the console last loaded the look from axHub). Needs axHub sync on.

entries.title: Restore previous pack
entries.text: Goes back to the icon pack in force before the last pack change.

entries.title: Restore pack from axHub
entries.text: Uses the icon pack axHub's look holds.

entries.title: Download template
entries.text: Downloads one icon pack file that maps every role in the app to a glyph, starting from the chosen pack. Change a line to change every place of that role, then import it as a pack.
entries.tryIt: CLI: node framework/cli/icon-map.mjs template --from amberx-outline --out my-pack.json

entries.title: Restore one slot
entries.text: icon-map.slot.restore:<slot id>:previous|hub. Restore previous edit, or Restore from axHub.

entries.title: Restore the icon pack
entries.text: icon-map.pack.restore:previous|hub.

entries.title: Download the icon pack template
entries.text: Downloads the icon pack template (every role mapped), optionally starting from a pack: icon-map.template:<pack id>.

entries.title: Reload
entries.text: Reads the map and the state again.

entries.title: Pick
entries.text: Choose the glyph this one place draws. The pick is saved and wins over the pack until Clear.

entries.title: Glyph
entries.text: The framework glyph this place draws. Picking one saves it at once.

entries.title: Clear
entries.text: Drops this place's pick; it follows the pack again.

entries.title: Icon map settings
entries.text: This plugin's tab under Settings → Plugins: open the page, install or uninstall the plugin.

entries.title: Open icon map
entries.text: Opens the Icon map page.

steps.say: Every place that shows an icon is a slot: an id, where it is, and a role such as save or approve.
Pick a pack and press Use pack: every icon follows at once. Fixed-colour packs keep their own colours.
Press Pick on one row to change that one place; Clear puts it back.
Everything here is also on REST, MCP, the CLI and voice: say "switch to the duotone icon pack".
